'''May 2000 Cedar Grove tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cedar Grove, NJ on 20 May 2000. [[Michael Dalton]] won it. It is known from Chris Gogolen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d782">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-cedar-grove-nj-5-20-00d782/ cedar-grove-nj-5-20-00], DeckTech (Chris "CGogolen" Gogolen, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-cedar-grove-nj-5-20-00d782/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Dalton]]
